from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancingCashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financing cash flow data from a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company from the filing")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label as written in the document (e.g. 'Net cash provided by financing activities')")
    amount_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount extracted from the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    flow_direction: str | None = Field(description="Whether cash was provided/inflow or used/outflow")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date the filing covers")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_cash_flow_records: list[FinancingCashFlowRecord]
